description: Register business risks on a 5×5 likelihood × impact matrix, score and band them (Low/Medium/High/Critical), and surface the top risks to act on first. Self-assessment — confirm with your auditor.
name: Operational Risk Heatmap

description: Tick fraud red flags (fake invoices, split purchases, ghost employees) for a fraud-risk score plus the preventive control for each gap. Diagnostic, not accusatory — a flag is a control gap, not proof.
name: Fraud Risk Indicator

description: Tick the controls you actually follow across purchase, sales, cash & bank, inventory and HR/payroll — get an overall compliance %, per-process scores and a prioritised gap list.
name: Internal Control Checklist

description: Answer 12 Yes/Partial/No questions across board oversight, compliance, transparency and financial discipline for a weighted 0–100 governance score, rating and improvement actions for weak areas.
name: Governance Score Engine

description: 12-item BCP checklist (backups, tested restores, alternate site, key-person cover, insurance) → readiness % and Resilient/Developing/Exposed tier with gaps to close.
name: Business Continuity Readiness Tool

description: List key roles, vendors and systems with dependency and backup coverage — get a ranked SPOF list (Critical/Watch/Covered) showing where one absence stops the business.
name: Single Point of Failure Detector

description: Map who has cash, bank, stock, purchase, payroll and bookkeeping access against their role — flag segregation-of-duties conflicts and rank misuse risk. Checks role design, not people.
name: Employee Misuse Risk Tool

description: Tick vendor-side indicators (same-address vendors, round-amount invoices, single-bidder patterns, sequential invoices) for a collusion-risk score plus the checks for each pattern.
name: Vendor Collusion Risk Tool

description: Answer 5 backup questions (frequency, locations, encryption, tested restores, device age) for a 0–100 data-loss risk score, RPO estimate and prioritised recommendations (3-2-1 rule).
name: Data Loss Probability Analyzer

description: Enter entity type, headcount and turnover — get the Indian statutory compliances that likely apply (GST, PF, ESI, Shops Act, Professional Tax, Udyam, ROC) with indicative due dates, and your gap list.
name: Compliance Gap Identifier
